readmeExcerpt: This module shows how a Java application can keep authorization policy close to the data in Oracle AI Database.
highlights: Alice sees only cases assigned to alice@example.com, with sensitive values masked.
Bob sees only the ACME East case assigned to bob@example.com.
Alice can update one assigned case, but Alice and Bob cannot update unauthorized cases.
Maria sees ACME West regional cases and can update one regional case.
metaTitle: JDBC Deep Data Security | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Plain JDBC sample showing support-case access guardrails with Oracle AI Database Deep Data Security and a local compatibility path.
